purpose: Onset-based Mininet zero-shot MissionShield evaluation campaign

campaign.preflight: benign engineering-only; excluded from telemetry and outcomes

forecast_evaluation.sample_rule: history i-9..i must be failure-free; full future i+1..i+H must exist; label is any mission failure in exactly that future window
forecast_evaluation.model: original frozen E1 MissionShield checkpoint for each horizon
forecast_evaluation.thresholds: use previously frozen E3-B calibration/operating thresholds where operational alarm metrics are reported

scope.primary: zero-shot forecasting transfer from synthetic training to real Mininet telemetry
scope.intervention: not part of initial E10-F forecasting campaign; evaluate only after forecasting telemetry/inference is frozen

integrity: All four non-benign conditions are retained regardless of whether they generate mission failures.
No severity is changed after outcomes.
No horizon is selected post hoc; H10/H30/H60 are all reported.
No emulator data are used to train or fine-tune MissionShield.
No attack/failure labels are used in detector_score calibration.
E10-D v7 smoke outcomes are not used for model or detector tuning.
If a condition produces zero positive forecast labels, report that fact and false-alarm behavior rather than manufacturing positives.
